name: Stalker's Fang (Shoanti)
body:
Source Inner Sea Races pg. 225
Aura faint transmutation CL 5th
Slot shield; Price 11,462 gp; Weight 6 lbs.
Description
The following suit of armor is generally available only to members of the indicated race or ethnicity.

The Shoanti craft this +1 keen klarUE from the skull of a horned spirestalker. Its enhancement bonus applies to attack rolls and damage rolls for attacks made with the blade, as well as to its shield bonus to AC. If the wielder confirms a critical hit against a creature that is denied its Dexterity bonus to AC, the target takes an additional 1d6 points of bleed damage.
Construction
Requirements Craft Magic Arms and Armor, bleed, keen edge, creator must be a Shoanti; Price 5,962 gp
